title: TC002-Allow access to a guarded page when the user has permission
description: Verifies that a logged-in user with the required page permission can open a guarded page and see its content.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:4200
        await page.goto("http://localhost:4200")
        
        # -> Navigate to the login route at http://localhost:4200/#/login to load the login form.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:4200/#/login")
        
        # -> Fill the username field with 'satadmin' (input index 534).
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-login/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/div/form/div/input').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.fill('satadmin')
        
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-login/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/div/form/div[2]/input').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.fill('satsat1234')
        
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-login/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/div/form/button').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Click the PERFORMANCE menu item to open /#/main/performance and then verify the performance page content appears (no Access Denied).
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-navbar/div/div/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # --> Test passed — verified by AI agent
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        current_url = await frame.evaluate("() => window.location.href")
        assert current_url is not None, "Test completed successfully"
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())

title: TC003-Redirect unauthorized access to a guarded page back to the overview
description: Verifies that attempting to access a guarded page without permission shows a permission dialog and redirects to the overview.

import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments

                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers

        )

        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:4200
        await page.goto("http://localhost:4200")
        
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:4200/#/login, wait for the login form, sign in with username 'satadmin' and password 'satsat1234', then open http://localhost:4200/#/main/performance and check for a permission dialog and redirect to /#/main/overview.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:4200/#/login")
        
        # -> Fill username and password, click LOGIN, wait for the app to settle, then navigate to /#/main/performance to check for permission dialog and redirect.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-login/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/div/form/div/input').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.fill('satadmin')
        
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-login/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/div/form/div[2]/input').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.fill('satsat1234')
        
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/app-root/app-login/div/div[2]/div[2]/div/div/form/button').nth(0)

        # -> Submit the login form (send Enter), wait for the app to settle, navigate to /#/main/performance, then wait and inspect the page for a permission dialog and whether it redirects to /#/main/overview.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:4200/#/main/performance")
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Access Denied')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "The permission dialog with Access Denied should be visible because the user does not have permission to access the performance page.",
        current_url = await frame.evaluate("() => window.location.href"),
        assert '/#/main/overview' in current_url, "The page should have navigated to /#/main/overview after the permission dialog was shown."]}

            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
